requirements.rule: Goal → Epic → Story → Task; vertical slices, INVEST and acceptance criteria before Ready.
Separate Scrum and historical source status; private board has Backlog plus Fast Track and Scrum Board lanes, with Offen → Bereit → In Arbeit → Review → Done and conscious Done confirmation.

Done requires acceptance criteria, source requirements, protection and approval gates, reproducible checks, traceability and consistent documentation; local, approved, pushed and live statuses stay distinct.
Phase-0 acceptance, specific release approval, review and publication decisions are distinct gates; earlier checks do not replace current acceptance.
Fast Track applies only to eligible high or critical board items under documented criteria and explicit approval; no autonomous prioritization.

MVP worker creates backlog items only on clear instruction and plans permitted items to Offen only when expressly commissioned; restricted rights, audit and negative cases; no autonomous move, prioritization or Done.
Unavoidable story dependencies and enabling follow-on stories are documented; tasks belong to stories and epic completion requires accepted stories.

One authoritative subject source per requirement, no competing backlog, and coverage and traceability gate before replacing a plan; existing design, privacy, security, image and release rules remain effective.
Source inventory, story tasks, traceability matrix and constraint register remain binding references.
